description: Use for charts, backtests, returns and volatility: returns open/high/low/close/adjusted close/volume bars for one ticker over a range (1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, ytd, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, max) at an interval (5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d, 1wk, 1mo; intraday 5m-30m only up to 1mo, 1h up to 2y). Also returns period return %, high/low and dividends/splits in the range. Default interval depends on range. Up to "limit" most recent bars. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

interval.description: Bar size; default depends on range (1d->5m, 5d->30m, 1mo-1y->1d, 2y/5y->1wk, 10y/max->1mo).
